paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah bar Chananyah: [Sifrei, Haazinu, beginning of chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Devarim.306.10).[^2]
Rabbi Yishmael ben Chananyah: [Avot deRabbi Natan, chapter 14](https://www.sefaria.org/Avot_DeRabbi_Natan.14.3).
Rabbi Pinchas ben Chananyah: [Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim, beginning of chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.1.6).
Rabbi Shmuel ben Chananyah: [Jerusalem Talmud Yoma, chapter 5, halakhah 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yoma.5.4.2).

notes.text: This notice groups people whose fathers are called Chananyah. It does not establish that all those fathers were one person. The consulted Sanhedrin 101a names Shimon ben Chananya.

The consulted Sifrei reads Yehudah ben Chananyah, where Hyman gives bar Chananyah. Avot deRabbi Natan mentions both Yehoshua and Yishmael with the same patronymic in its list of students. Each link supports the individual name listed.
